scene.label: Act 4, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Rome. A Room in the Palace
scene.location: Rome. A Room in the Palace

content.text: Enter Aaron, Chiron and Demetrius at one door, and at the other door Young Lucius and another, with a bundle of weapons and verses writ upon them.

lines.text: Demetrius, here's the son of Lucius;
lines.plainText: Demetrius here's the son of Lucius

lines.text: He hath some message to deliver us.
lines.plainText: He hath some message to deliver us

lines.text: Ay, some mad message from his mad grandfather.
lines.plainText: Ay some mad message from his mad grandfather

lines.text: My lords, with all the humbleness I may,
lines.plainText: My lords with all the humbleness I may

lines.text: I greet your honours from Andronicus;
lines.plainText: I greet your honours from Andronicus

lines.text: [Aside.] And pray the Roman gods confound you both.
lines.plainText: Aside And pray the Roman gods confound you both

lines.text: Gramercy, lovely Lucius. What's the news?
lines.plainText: Gramercy lovely Lucius What's the news

lines.text: [Aside.] That you are both deciphered, that's the news,
lines.plainText: Aside That you are both deciphered that's the news

lines.text: For villains marked with rape. [Aloud.] May it please you,
lines.plainText: For villains marked with rape Aloud May it please you

lines.text: My grandsire, well advised, hath sent by me
lines.plainText: My grandsire well advised hath sent by me

lines.text: The goodliest weapons of his armoury
lines.plainText: The goodliest weapons of his armoury

lines.text: To gratify your honourable youth,
lines.plainText: To gratify your honourable youth

lines.text: The hope of Rome; for so he bid me say;
lines.plainText: The hope of Rome for so he bid me say

lines.text: And so I do, and with his gifts present
lines.plainText: And so I do and with his gifts present

lines.text: Your lordships, that, whenever you have need,
lines.plainText: Your lordships that whenever you have need

lines.text: You may be armed and appointed well.
lines.plainText: You may be armed and appointed well

lines.text: And so I leave you both, [Aside.] like bloody villains.
lines.plainText: And so I leave you both Aside like bloody villains

lines.text: What's here? A scroll; and written round about?
lines.plainText: What's here A scroll and written round about

lines.text: Let's see:
lines.plainText: Let's see

lines.text: [Reads.] Integer vitae, scelerisque purus,
lines.plainText: Reads Integer vitae scelerisque purus

lines.text: Non eget Mauri iaculis, nec arcu.
lines.plainText: Non eget Mauri iaculis nec arcu

lines.text: O, 'tis a verse in Horace; I know it well.
lines.plainText: O 'tis a verse in Horace I know it well

lines.text: I read it in the grammar long ago.
lines.plainText: I read it in the grammar long ago

lines.text: Ay, just; a verse in Horace; right, you have it.
lines.plainText: Ay just a verse in Horace right you have it

lines.text: [Aside.] Now, what a thing it is to be an ass!
lines.plainText: Aside Now what a thing it is to be an ass

lines.text: Here's no sound jest! The old man hath found their guilt,
lines.plainText: Here's no sound jest The old man hath found their guilt

lines.text: And sends them weapons wrapped about with lines,
lines.plainText: And sends them weapons wrapped about with lines

lines.text: That wound, beyond their feeling, to the quick.
lines.plainText: That wound beyond their feeling to the quick

lines.text: But were our witty empress well afoot,
lines.plainText: But were our witty empress well afoot

lines.text: She would applaud Andronicus' conceit.
lines.plainText: She would applaud Andronicus' conceit

lines.text: But let her rest in her unrest awhile.—
lines.plainText: But let her rest in her unrest awhile

lines.text: And now, young lords, was't not a happy star
lines.plainText: And now young lords was't not a happy star

lines.text: Led us to Rome, strangers, and more than so,
lines.plainText: Led us to Rome strangers and more than so

lines.text: Captives, to be advanced to this height?
lines.plainText: Captives to be advanced to this height

lines.text: It did me good before the palace gate
lines.plainText: It did me good before the palace gate

lines.text: To brave the tribune in his brother's hearing.
lines.plainText: To brave the tribune in his brother's hearing

lines.text: But me more good to see so great a lord
lines.plainText: But me more good to see so great a lord

lines.text: Basely insinuate and send us gifts.
lines.plainText: Basely insinuate and send us gifts

lines.text: Had he not reason, Lord Demetrius?
lines.plainText: Had he not reason Lord Demetrius

lines.text: Did you not use his daughter very friendly?
lines.plainText: Did you not use his daughter very friendly

lines.text: I would we had a thousand Roman dames
lines.plainText: I would we had a thousand Roman dames

lines.text: At such a bay, by turn to serve our lust.
lines.plainText: At such a bay by turn to serve our lust

lines.text: A charitable wish, and full of love.
lines.plainText: A charitable wish and full of love

lines.text: Here lacks but your mother for to say amen.
lines.plainText: Here lacks but your mother for to say amen

lines.text: And that would she for twenty thousand more.
lines.plainText: And that would she for twenty thousand more

lines.text: Come, let us go and pray to all the gods
lines.plainText: Come let us go and pray to all the gods

lines.text: For our beloved mother in her pains.
lines.plainText: For our beloved mother in her pains

lines.text: [Aside.] Pray to the devils; the gods have given us over.
lines.plainText: Aside Pray to the devils the gods have given us over

lines.text: Why do the emperor's trumpets flourish thus?
lines.plainText: Why do the emperor's trumpets flourish thus

lines.text: Belike for joy the emperor hath a son.
lines.plainText: Belike for joy the emperor hath a son

lines.text: Soft, who comes here?
lines.plainText: Soft who comes here

content.text: Enter Nurse with a blackamoor Child in her arms.

lines.text: Good morrow, lords.
lines.plainText: Good morrow lords

lines.text: O, tell me, did you see Aaron the Moor?
lines.plainText: O tell me did you see Aaron the Moor

lines.text: Well, more or less, or ne'er a whit at all,
lines.plainText: Well more or less or ne'er a whit at all

lines.text: Here Aaron is; and what with Aaron now?
lines.plainText: Here Aaron is and what with Aaron now

lines.text: O gentle Aaron, we are all undone!
lines.plainText: O gentle Aaron we are all undone

lines.text: Now help, or woe betide thee evermore!
lines.plainText: Now help or woe betide thee evermore

lines.text: Why, what a caterwauling dost thou keep!
lines.plainText: Why what a caterwauling dost thou keep

lines.text: What dost thou wrap and fumble in thy arms?
lines.plainText: What dost thou wrap and fumble in thy arms

lines.text: O, that which I would hide from heaven's eye,
lines.plainText: O that which I would hide from heaven's eye

lines.text: Our empress' shame and stately Rome's disgrace.
lines.plainText: Our empress' shame and stately Rome's disgrace

lines.text: She is delivered, lords, she is delivered.
lines.plainText: She is delivered lords she is delivered

lines.text: To whom?
lines.plainText: To whom

lines.text: I mean, she's brought a-bed.
lines.plainText: I mean she's brought abed

lines.text: Well, God give her good rest! What hath he sent her?
lines.plainText: Well God give her good rest What hath he sent her

lines.text: A devil.
lines.plainText: A devil

lines.text: Why, then she is the devil's dam. A joyful issue.
lines.plainText: Why then she is the devil's dam A joyful issue

lines.text: A joyless, dismal, black, and sorrowful issue.
lines.plainText: A joyless dismal black and sorrowful issue

lines.text: Here is the babe, as loathsome as a toad
lines.plainText: Here is the babe as loathsome as a toad

lines.text: Amongst the fair-faced breeders of our clime.
lines.plainText: Amongst the fairfaced breeders of our clime

lines.text: The empress sends it thee, thy stamp, thy seal,
lines.plainText: The empress sends it thee thy stamp thy seal

lines.text: And bids thee christen it with thy dagger's point.
lines.plainText: And bids thee christen it with thy dagger's point

lines.text: Zounds, ye whore, is black so base a hue?
lines.plainText: Zounds ye whore is black so base a hue

lines.text: Sweet blowse, you are a beauteous blossom sure.
lines.plainText: Sweet blowse you are a beauteous blossom sure

lines.text: Villain, what hast thou done?
lines.plainText: Villain what hast thou done

lines.text: That which thou canst not undo.
lines.plainText: That which thou canst not undo

lines.text: Thou hast undone our mother.
lines.plainText: Thou hast undone our mother

lines.text: Villain, I have done thy mother.
lines.plainText: Villain I have done thy mother

lines.text: And therein, hellish dog, thou hast undone her.
lines.plainText: And therein hellish dog thou hast undone her

lines.text: Woe to her chance, and damned her loathed choice!
lines.plainText: Woe to her chance and damned her loathed choice

lines.text: Accursed the offspring of so foul a fiend!
lines.plainText: Accursed the offspring of so foul a fiend

lines.text: It shall not live.
lines.plainText: It shall not live

lines.text: It shall not die.
lines.plainText: It shall not die

lines.text: Aaron, it must; the mother wills it so.
lines.plainText: Aaron it must the mother wills it so

lines.text: What, must it, nurse? Then let no man but I
lines.plainText: What must it nurse Then let no man but I

lines.text: Do execution on my flesh and blood.
lines.plainText: Do execution on my flesh and blood

lines.text: I'll broach the tadpole on my rapier's point.
lines.plainText: I'll broach the tadpole on my rapier's point

lines.text: Nurse, give it me; my sword shall soon dispatch it.
lines.plainText: Nurse give it me my sword shall soon dispatch it

lines.text: Sooner this sword shall plough thy bowels up.
lines.plainText: Sooner this sword shall plough thy bowels up

lines.text: Wilt thou betray thy noble mistress thus?
lines.plainText: Wilt thou betray thy noble mistress thus

lines.text: My mistress is my mistress; this my self;
lines.plainText: My mistress is my mistress this my self

lines.text: The vigour and the picture of my youth.
lines.plainText: The vigour and the picture of my youth

lines.text: This before all the world do I prefer;
lines.plainText: This before all the world do I prefer

lines.text: This maugre all the world will I keep safe,
lines.plainText: This maugre all the world will I keep safe

lines.text: Or some of you shall smoke for it in Rome.
lines.plainText: Or some of you shall smoke for it in Rome

lines.text: By this our mother is for ever shamed.
lines.plainText: By this our mother is for ever shamed

lines.text: Rome will despise her for this foul escape.
lines.plainText: Rome will despise her for this foul escape

lines.text: The emperor in his rage will doom her death.
lines.plainText: The emperor in his rage will doom her death

lines.text: I blush to think upon this ignomy.
lines.plainText: I blush to think upon this ignomy

lines.text: Why, there's the privilege your beauty bears.
lines.plainText: Why there's the privilege your beauty bears

lines.text: Fie, treacherous hue, that will betray with blushing
lines.plainText: Fie treacherous hue that will betray with blushing

lines.text: The close enacts and counsels of thy heart!
lines.plainText: The close enacts and counsels of thy heart

lines.text: Here's a young lad framed of another leer.
lines.plainText: Here's a young lad framed of another leer

lines.text: Look how the black slave smiles upon the father,
lines.plainText: Look how the black slave smiles upon the father

lines.text: As who should say "Old lad, I am thine own."
lines.plainText: As who should say Old lad I am thine own

lines.text: He is your brother, lords, sensibly fed
lines.plainText: He is your brother lords sensibly fed

lines.text: Of that self blood that first gave life to you;
lines.plainText: Of that self blood that first gave life to you

lines.text: And from your womb where you imprisoned were
lines.plainText: And from your womb where you imprisoned were

lines.text: He is enfranchised and come to light.
lines.plainText: He is enfranchised and come to light

lines.text: Nay, he is your brother by the surer side,
lines.plainText: Nay he is your brother by the surer side

lines.text: Although my seal be stamped in his face.
lines.plainText: Although my seal be stamped in his face

lines.text: Aaron, what shall I say unto the empress?
lines.plainText: Aaron what shall I say unto the empress

lines.text: Advise thee, Aaron, what is to be done,
lines.plainText: Advise thee Aaron what is to be done

lines.text: And we will all subscribe to thy advice.
lines.plainText: And we will all subscribe to thy advice

lines.text: Save thou the child, so we may all be safe.
lines.plainText: Save thou the child so we may all be safe

lines.text: Then sit we down, and let us all consult.
lines.plainText: Then sit we down and let us all consult

lines.text: My son and I will have the wind of you.
lines.plainText: My son and I will have the wind of you

lines.text: Keep there. Now talk at pleasure of your safety.
lines.plainText: Keep there Now talk at pleasure of your safety

lines.text: How many women saw this child of his?
lines.plainText: How many women saw this child of his

lines.text: Why, so, brave lords! When we join in league,
lines.plainText: Why so brave lords When we join in league

lines.text: I am a lamb; but if you brave the Moor,
lines.plainText: I am a lamb but if you brave the Moor

lines.text: The chafed boar, the mountain lioness,
lines.plainText: The chafed boar the mountain lioness

lines.text: The ocean swells not so as Aaron storms.
lines.plainText: The ocean swells not so as Aaron storms

lines.text: But say again, how many saw the child?
lines.plainText: But say again how many saw the child

lines.text: Cornelia the midwife and myself,
lines.plainText: Cornelia the midwife and myself

lines.text: And no one else but the delivered empress.
lines.plainText: And no one else but the delivered empress

lines.text: The empress, the midwife, and yourself.
lines.plainText: The empress the midwife and yourself

lines.text: Two may keep counsel when the third's away.
lines.plainText: Two may keep counsel when the third's away

lines.text: Go to the empress; tell her this I said.
lines.plainText: Go to the empress tell her this I said

lines.text: What mean'st thou, Aaron? Wherefore didst thou this?
lines.plainText: What mean'st thou Aaron Wherefore didst thou this

lines.text: O Lord, sir, 'tis a deed of policy.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir 'tis a deed of policy

lines.text: Shall she live to betray this guilt of ours,
lines.plainText: Shall she live to betray this guilt of ours

lines.text: A long-tongued babbling gossip? No, lords, no.
lines.plainText: A longtongued babbling gossip No lords no

lines.text: And now be it known to you my full intent.
lines.plainText: And now be it known to you my full intent

lines.text: Not far, one Muliteus lives, my countryman;
lines.plainText: Not far one Muliteus lives my countryman

lines.text: His wife but yesternight was brought to bed.
lines.plainText: His wife but yesternight was brought to bed

lines.text: His child is like to her, fair as you are.
lines.plainText: His child is like to her fair as you are

lines.text: Go pack with him, and give the mother gold,
lines.plainText: Go pack with him and give the mother gold

lines.text: And tell them both the circumstance of all,
lines.plainText: And tell them both the circumstance of all

lines.text: And how by this their child shall be advanced,
lines.plainText: And how by this their child shall be advanced

lines.text: And be received for the emperor's heir,
lines.plainText: And be received for the emperor's heir

lines.text: And substituted in the place of mine,
lines.plainText: And substituted in the place of mine

lines.text: To calm this tempest whirling in the court;
lines.plainText: To calm this tempest whirling in the court

lines.text: And let the emperor dandle him for his own.
lines.plainText: And let the emperor dandle him for his own

lines.text: Hark ye, lords; ye see I have given her physic,
lines.plainText: Hark ye lords ye see I have given her physic

lines.text: Aaron, I see thou wilt not trust the air
lines.plainText: Aaron I see thou wilt not trust the air

lines.text: With secrets.
lines.plainText: With secrets

lines.text: For this care of Tamora,
lines.plainText: For this care of Tamora

lines.text: Herself and hers are highly bound to thee.
lines.plainText: Herself and hers are highly bound to thee

content.text: [Exeunt Demetrius and Chiron, carrying the Nurse's body.]

lines.text: Now to the Goths, as swift as swallow flies,
lines.plainText: Now to the Goths as swift as swallow flies

lines.text: There to dispose this treasure in mine arms,
lines.plainText: There to dispose this treasure in mine arms

lines.text: And secretly to greet the empress' friends.
lines.plainText: And secretly to greet the empress' friends

lines.text: Come on, you thick-lipped slave, I'll bear you hence;
lines.plainText: Come on you thicklipped slave I'll bear you hence

lines.text: For it is you that puts us to our shifts.
lines.plainText: For it is you that puts us to our shifts

lines.text: I'll make you feed on berries and on roots,
lines.plainText: I'll make you feed on berries and on roots

lines.text: And feed on curds and whey, and suck the goat,
lines.plainText: And feed on curds and whey and suck the goat

lines.text: And cabin in a cave, and bring you up
lines.plainText: And cabin in a cave and bring you up

lines.text: To be a warrior and command a camp.
lines.plainText: To be a warrior and command a camp
